name: promptlock_patch_v1
purpose: optional training-time legality mask with the 35-token prompt locked (config training.legality_mask, default off): before the cross-entropy (train and dev), MOVE logits that would land left of prefix_len or right of the canvas end, and the DELETE logit at cursor <= prefix_len, are set to -inf; a gold label that is illegal under this mask raises (never a silent infinite loss)
applies_to: the July-control work tree ($R/work/src from ov_prepare.sh / big_prepare.sh step 6: bundle code/src + patches/pretrain_resttraj.patched.py); the result is a superset of work_lm/src (lossmask_patch_v1)
build: bash scripts/humanorder/promptlock_patch_v1/make_tree.sh WORK_SRC OUT_SRC   (checks all input and output sha256s)

pretrain_resttraj.py.change: reads training.legality_mask (default false); when true: collators built with legality_state=True, _promptlock_mask_logits applied to the logits before CE in the train loop and in evaluate_resttraj_dev, counters printed as '[promptlock] step=... labels_checked=... illegal_labels=0 nonfinite_losses=...' at each log step and '[promptlock] final: ...' at the end; an illegal gold label prints '[promptlock] FATAL ...' (first 10 positions) and raises RuntimeError. When false: no code on the training path changes (same RNG use, same tensors).

resttraj_pretrain_collator.py.change: lossmask_patch_v1 collator + cursor_state_before_actions() and constructor flag legality_state (default False). When True the batch also has legal_cursor / legal_canvas_len (B, S) long: the executor's cursor and canvas length BEFORE each action (input position t predicts actions[t] from the state after actions[:t]); 0 at padding. When False the output is identical to lossmask_patch_v1.

raining_resttraj_bucketed_dataset.py.change: none relative to lossmask_patch_v1 (copied unchanged so the tree is self-contained)

rule.positions: label position t (actions[t]); state = executor state after actions[:t] (insert at cursor then cursor+1; DELETE pops the token left of the cursor, no-op at 0; moves clamp to [0, len])
rule.illegal_move: cursor + amt < prefix_len  or  cursor + amt > canvas_len   (landing exactly on prefix_len is legal)
rule.never_masked: inserts, EOR, every other token (so no all -inf row and no NaN)
rule.prefix_len: batch prefix_lens from prefix_len_shardK.npy (35 for the July/C4 prompt arms)

tests: tmp/promptlock/train.ready.json and notes/promptlock-2026-10-08.md (data scan, collator vs reference, model CE check, CPU trainer smokes A/B/C)
ddp_compat: scripts/humanorder/big608/ddp_patch.py (sha256 3f2496999da6...) applies to this trainer: 15 edits, output sha256 ac8316466e67840dde4ae7d4bfc660e44393e04c668ef8f0a73cefbdd83c604d, py_compile OK (not run under torchrun here)
